messages:
Kara: Kicking off a slightly different onboarding thread 1: this one focuses on KMS integration, EU localization copy, and billing edge cases for the AWS/GCP/Azure storefront listing. Goal: preflight to staging by next Wed. Need owners for KMS docs, EU legal text, localized screenshots, and promo code handling.
Diego: I'll own EU legal + EULA addendum. Note: EU requires a stronger data residency blurb and explicit retention window. Share the model list if we reference third-party weights.
Owen: I'll take billing + promo flow. Question: do marketplace promo codes map to our billing backend or are they handled entirely by the cloud marketplace? Need to confirm.
Linh: Eng: will draft KMS integration snippets and guidance for both cloud KMS and customer-managed keys. Also will provide a quick terraform example.
Sana: I'll handle localized assets (FR/DE/EN) and short-form copy. I'll need approved translations for the hero blurb and CTA.
marketplace-bot: :pushpin: New asset spec uploaded: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/assets/specs-kms-localization.md (rev 1754000000)
Kara: Quick constraints:
- For EU customers we must show a clear "Data residency: EU available" toggle on listing.
- For KMS, we support encrypted payloads with customer-managed keys (CMK) on Dedicated and Private only. Hosted API uses Redwood KMS.
Diego: Add to legal checklist: "customer-managed-key disclosure" + "EU data residency statement". I'll draft language: "Customers opting into CMK are responsible for key rotation & access logs; Redwood will not retain key material."
Owen: About promos: most marketplaces let the platform apply discounts, but we need mapping for metered billing vs subscription. For subscription SKUs we can rely on marketplace coupons; for metered token usage we need to handle discounting in our billing layer. I'll sync with finance.
Linh: Terraform snippet for publisher to attach a customer-managed key (GCP example):
```
resource "google_kms_key_ring" "rwd_ring" {
  name     = "rwd-keyring"
  location = "europe-west1"
}

resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "rwd_key" {
  name     = "rwd-cmk"
  key_ring = google_kms_key_ring.rwd_ring.id
  rotation_period = "7776000s" # 90 days
}
```
Sana: For localization, propose hero blurbs: EN: "Predictable multi-cloud LLM inference." FR: "Inférence LLM multi-cloud, coûts prévisibles." DE: "Skalierbare LLM-Inferenz über mehrere Clouds." Prefer short CTAs: EN: "Start trial" / FR: "De9marrer le9ssai" / DE: "Test starten". Any objections?
Diego: Looks good. Legal prefers not to include SLA numbers in non-enterprise bullets. Keep performance claims generic and reserve specific SLAs to a linked doc.
Kara: Action owners recap:
- Diego: EU legal text + CMK disclosure (48h)
- Owen: billing promo mapping + finance sync (72h)
- Linh: KMS snippets + terraform examples + sample IAM roles (48h)
- Sana: localized assets + CTA translations (48h)
marketplace-bot: :warning: Compliance check: upload signed privacy_manifest.pdf and kms_policy_doc.pdf before requesting staging.
Owen: One billing edge-case: if a customer redeems a marketplace promo for a subscription, and then upgrades to a metered add-on, how do we prorate? Finance will confirm but we need a note on the listing about promo applicability.
Linh: IAM sample (Azure) to attach to publisher manifest:
```
# Azure: give managed identity Reader + Storage Blob Data Reader
az role assignment create --assignee <managed-identity-id> --role "Reader" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>
az role assignment create --assignee <managed-identity-id> --role "Storage Blob Data Reader" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/<acct>
```
Sana: Small UX ask: localized screenshots should show the CTA in the correct language. I'll produce 3 sets of hero images and a short screenshot of the onboarding flow with localized labels.
Diego: Also flag: if we list "supports CMK" we must show a short troubleshooting note about failed key permissions on initial provisioning. I'll add that to the legal/ops checklist.
Kara: Can we have a 30-min review Thurs 9:30 AM PT to validate drafts? I'll send invite.
Owen: Works.
Linh: In calendar.
Sana: I'll be there.
Diego: Adding final note: include a checkbox for "promo applicability to trial" and "promo applicability to metered add-ons" in the manifest.
Kara: Thanks team 1 :rocket: I'll upload the initial manifest and the shared folder link here once ready: /Shared/marketplace/onboards/1755554321
